audited_candidate_bundle.ordered_manifest_hash_rule: sha256 of UTF-8 canonical minified ordered array of path, sha256, bytes rows

blockers.title: Qualification trusts driver-authored rollout assertions without reopening primary rollout bytes

evidence.verifier_rollout_checks: rollout_path prefix plus sha256 shape plus positive byte count only

blockers.finding: The same driver that dispatches the subject call reopens the rollout and emits the receipt. The independent verifier accepts the receipt's rollout_path, rollout_storage_sha256, rollout_storage_bytes, provider identity, thread_id, turn_id, final messages, prohibited activity, and timing without reopening the referenced rollout file or recomputing those fields. Capture, score, path terminal, matrix terminal, manifest, reopen, and two-run qualification then derive only from that self-authored receipt.
blockers.impact: An internally consistent fabricated receipt can name a nonexistent or unrelated rollout and arbitrary unique thread and turn strings while still supporting PASS scores and clean terminal chains. Fresh task, one turn, exact provider packet, requested route, opaque raw capture, first attempt, prohibited-activity absence, and 291 or 582 primary call identities are therefore not independently established.
blockers.required_repair: Make the verifier lstat and reopen each exact rollout path, bind its current storage hash and bytes, strictly parse the JSONL, independently recompute session, thread, one-turn, task_started/task_complete, wrapper/provider-payload, requested route, final-message, prohibited-activity, and timing evidence, and reject any receipt field not byte-derived from that primary source.

blockers.title: Two-run qualification compares an unchecked freeze-digest string rather than validating a candidate freeze manifest
blockers.finding: run_contract validates candidate_freeze_sha256 only by regular expression. qualify_two_runs requires the two strings to be equal and then emits byte_identical_candidate_across_runs=true. It never resolves, reopens, hashes, or validates an external freeze manifest and never proves that the digest covers the exact candidate, audit, driver, verifier, harness, fixture, and required dependency bytes.
blockers.impact: Two clean-looking run roots can qualify against the same arbitrary 64-hex token even when no candidate freeze exists or the runs used different executable or dependency bytes.
blockers.required_repair: Bind a fixed external freeze-manifest path and schema, reopen canonical manifest storage, match its storage digest, validate its exact candidate and dependency inventory against current regular-file bytes before every admission and terminal operation, and require both runs to reference the same validated manifest identity.

blockers.title: The v4 semantic-oracle and downstream equivalence baseline dynamically executes an unbound v4 harness
blockers.finding: The preflight binds the v4 deterministic report but imports and executes model_retest_r8_candidate_v4/r8_harness.py to establish all 93 unaffected semantic-oracle identities and every downstream stage identity. That executable is absent from FROZEN_BINDINGS and architecture_contract.runtime_dependency_closure.
blockers.impact: The claimed v4 oracle and S10-S90 equivalence are observed against mutable external code rather than a complete frozen dependency closure. The exact current bytes pass, but the invariant is not sealed or reproducible from the declared bindings.
blockers.required_repair: Add the exact v4 harness hash and byte count to the enforced dependency closure and external freeze manifest, or replace dynamic comparison with immutable independently bound oracle and per-stage identities that do not execute an unbound baseline.

residual_risks.statement: The fixture creator's no-scorer and no-prior-answer read history is a declarative attestation. This audit verified exact current source, capsule, hash, excerpt, claim-span, schedule, and packet bytes but cannot mechanically reconstruct the creator's historical read set.

Requested model, effort, openai provider, host label, thread, and turn are the available identities. A separate provider-effective serving snapshot and separate platform task_id are not exposed; the contracts state this limitation.

root_controller_only is a publication protocol label rather than authenticated caller identity. Deterministic finalization does require all paths to be stopped, but the executable cannot distinguish a root controller process from another caller.

Prohibited subject activity detection enumerates known response-item tool-call types. Future app-server item types require fail-closed schema maintenance so an unknown tool-capable item cannot evade the prohibition.

passed_boundaries: Exact current candidate JSON and Python syntax are valid.
Stored deterministic preflight is exactly reproducible with zero subject or provider calls and no bytecode cache.
All 22 frozen source records, including sources used only by excluded candidates, match full-file hashes, capsule metadata, and exact line-range excerpts.
Every candidate text is partitioned by exact gap-free claim spans; all four eligible candidates have complete declared source closures and both unsupported candidates are excluded before rendering.
All four provider packets omit controller adjudication, reasons, expected booleans, old ternary labels, selected tension IDs, scorer keys, sibling candidates, and prior-run outputs.
The 97-cell schedule and four tension cells are derived from fixture order and boolean claim support; driver and verifier contain no tension-ID answer branches.
All four boolean packets are route-invariant renders with one objective, strict boolean schema, at most 4480 provider bytes, at most 3383 admitted context bytes, and exactly 10 instruction lines.
The 93 unaffected provider packets and semantic oracles are byte-identical to the current v4 baseline, subject to blocker C5-PRESEAL-B003.

All 58 distinct holdout bodies pass, including renamed and reordered data, true and false domains, unsupported exclusion, malformed response and decomposition cases, source tamper, and slot-model-route metamorphism.
Correct boolean outcomes reproduce the current v4 S10-S90 deterministic bytes and terminal payload, subject to blocker C5-PRESEAL-B003.
Candidate-v4 run-01 remains a valid reopened first-attempt-failure matrix with zero qualification credit; its three failures are not reinterpreted.
